scope: First production release with the legacy functional baseline; post-launch growth (Phase 7) excluded.
basis: Planning estimate, not elapsed effort or test coverage. Fixed phase weights total 100; work packages are equal-weight within a phase. score 1 = implemented with relevant evidence, 0.5 = partial or current verification/acceptance incomplete, 0 = absent/unverified. Phase acceptance is separate and requires every quality gate.
nextWorkstream: Finish customer/supplier lifecycle and independent settlements with treasury dependencies; implement remaining document, report, dashboard and admin bindings. Continue exact source coverage, complete keyboard/device checks and owner acceptance. Closed-period policy is awaiting the owner choice.
